test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 06 Feb 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which among the following Union Ministers of India inaugurated the 25th National Conference on e-Governance (NCeG) held in Katra, Jammu & Kashmir in November 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Jitendra Singh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• ** National Conference on e-Governance (NCeG) is an annual event organized by the Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances (DARPG) in collaboration with the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY).**
 
• The conference provides a platform for government officials, industry experts, and academicians to discuss and share their experiences and best practices in the field of e-governance.
 
• **The theme for the 25th NCeG held in Katra**, Jammu Kashmir in November 2022 was **"Digital Governance: New Frontiers".**
 
• Jitendra Singh, Union Minister of State (Independent Charge) for Development of North Eastern Region, MoS PMO, Personnel, Public Grievances, Pensions, Atomic Energy and Space, inaugurated the 25th National Conference on e-Governance (NCeG) held in Katra, Jammu undefined Kashmir in November 2022.
 
• The 25th National Conference on e-Governance was held in Katra, Jammu & Kashmir on Nov 26, 2022.
 
• Department of Administrative Reforms & Public Grievances DARPG and the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology are organizing it.
 
• This conference will be a platform for discussion on some of these technologies by inviting distinguished speakers to share their knowledge and insights on the subject.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Arjun Munda **is the** Union Minister for Tribal Affairs.**
 
• ** Piyush Goyal **is the** Union Minister for Commerce and Industry.**
 
• **Pralhad Joshi **is the** Union Minister for Coal and Mines.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• E-governance, meaning 'electronic governance' is using information and communication technologies.
 
• Such as Wide Area Networks, the Internet, and mobile computing, at various levels of the government and the public sector and beyond, for the purpose of enhancing governance.
 
• The theme of the 25th Conference is “Bringing Citizens, Industry and Government closer”.
 
• 24th National Conference on e-Governance 2021 concludes at Hyderabad.
